liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Black Peter** (2 reviews): Played for a second night running and in three of the last five shows; Reportedly Garcia was a bit under the weather, and the band stumbled into this song [17][18]
- **the other one** (1 review, 1 other source): Good move out of space, though the playing is somewhat clunky; The space segment is included within the Other One track [1][19]
- **Jack Straw** (1 review): Lyrics and melody work very well, though the band flubbed the closing vocals [15]
- **west LA fadeaway** (1 review): A listener in the crowd cheers loudly for it, and this version crackles with energy [15]
- **crazy fingers** (1 review): A great version, but short, with Garcia's voice sounding weak [19]
- **playin' in the band** (1 review): The transition from Playin' into Crazy Fingers is nice [19]

## Setlist highlights

- **gd88-04-08 t01 Crowd**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [24]
- **gd88-04-08 t02 Jack Straw**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [24]
- **gd88-04-08 t03 West LA Fadeaway**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [24]
- **gd88-04-08 t04 Little Red Rooster**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [24]
- **gd88-04-08 t05 Stagger Lee**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [24]
- **gd88-04-08 t06 Queen Jane Approximately**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [24]
- **gd88-04-08 t07 Loser**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [24]
- **gd88-04-08 t08 Let It Grow**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [24]

## The recordings

- **gd1988-04-08.142253.schoeps.cmc4.mk41.mattes.miller.clugston.flac1644** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 19 songs; 125 min [1]
- **gd1988-04-08.sbd.miller.91240.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 16 songs; 122 min; rated 2.5/5 by 4 [3]. Said about its sound: Reviewer says Miller's remaster of the soundboard sounds fine [22]
- **gd1988-04-08.156451.UltraMatrix.sbd.cm.miller.t.flac1644**: soundboard; 16 songs; 122 min [4]
- **gd88-04-08.fm.willy.15128.sbeok.shnf**: FM broadcast; 16 songs; 117 min; rated 3.36/5 by 11 [7]. Said about its sound: Reviewer finds the mix excellent, with Garcia's voice sounding especially good in the first set; Good sound for a source that isn't a direct soundboard, and it picks up the crowd well; Very good recording, without the radio static heard on the previous night's tape [13][14][21]

## Around the show

- Attendee recalls a tour cough going around the crowd, and Garcia felt unwell that night [23]
- Reviewer ranks this the weakest of the three Worcester nights, though not bad [17]
- Attendee thought it weak at the time, but twenty years on finds it average with some above-average moments [20]
- Like the night before, it's a very short show; the first set fit on one tape side [21]
- Reviewer believes this was the shortest show of the tour, with short songs [23]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1988-04-08.142253.schoeps.cmc4.mk41.mattes.miller.clugston.flac1644**: taped by Ted Mattes; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: Source Info: Ted Mattes' Master Audience PCM (Nakamichi DMP-100 deck); Schoeps CMC4/MK41 mics, ortf (1st row center, OTS, directly behind soundboard); Transfer… [1]
- **gd1988-04-08.sbd.miller.91240.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master (TDK SA-X90) D [3]. Also: This soundboard version is a remaster by C Miller; Healy's in-house FM feed went to PCM, then DAT, then CD; Joe B. Jones helped with pitch correction [3][22]
- **gd1988-04-08.156451.UltraMatrix.sbd.cm.miller.t.flac1644**: taped by Recorded by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; transferred by All Transfers and Mastering by Charlie Miller  March 10, 2022; source: Ultramatrix SBD > Cassette Master (Sony TC-D5M/TDK MA-XG90) [4]. Also: Several Ultramatrix masters were combined to make the show complete [4]
- **gd88-04-08.fm.willy.15128.sbeok.shnf**: source: In-House FM>PCM>Dat>CD via Mike Murray [7]
